title: Workforce & Trade
tagline: Skills labs, certification, DOL-funded programs, economic mobility.
overview: Workforce twins capture skills labs and training floors so learners can rehearse procedures and equipment before touching the real thing — the fastest-growing segment in immersive training, and the one most tied to funded economic-mobility programs.

project.name: Laser-Scanned VR Training Environment
project.blurb: A real industrial workspace laser-scanned and integrated into VR, where trainees rehearse trade skills in a dimensionally accurate copy of the floor they'll work on. Companion builds include the Metal Shark shipbuilding demo and AR equipment overviews with hands-on interaction.

capturedWith: Laser scan + XR tools for Unity

media.label: Laser Scanned Environment Integrated into VR — Demo

links.label: Energy Equipment Overview with AR interaction

evidence.Case Studies: Laser-scanned VR training floor — trainees rehearse trade procedures in an exact spatial copy of the real workspace; Metal Shark shipbuilding demo extends the same approach to marine manufacturing.
evidence.Client Feedback: “We can pre-train a cohort before they ever queue for a machine.”
evidence.Press & Research: Immersive training is the fastest-growing segment of the workforce-development market.
evidence.Project Data: Laser scan + VR integration · AR equipment modules · Reusable across every cohort.
